verses.text: Ayik tz'och suerte yik spukchajek' lum lum t'a junjun inhtilal, yowalil ch'ok tz'ik'chajkanel jab'ok lu'um wik tz'ajkan a in Jehová in tik, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel lu'um, oye' kilómetro sat lu'um. Masanil jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', hata' tz'ik'jikanel junok makan lum b'aj skan templo, 250 metro tz'aj lum t'a schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a spatiktak lum chi' skan pax jab'ok lum kolan tz'ajkani, 25 metro sat.
Ha jun makan lum chi' yik heb' sakerdote smunlaj t'a templo tz'aj lu'um, haton heb' tz'och t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil. Hata' syal sb'oank'e spat heb' t'a spatiktak in templo chi'.

Hanheja' tz'ik'chajkanel junxo makan lum lum, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo steel, oye' kilómetro sat. Ha jun lum chi', yik heb' lewita tz'ajkan lu'um, haton heb' smunlaj t'a templo yik wach' ay b'aj sb'ok'e spat heb' b'aj skajnaji.

Haxo t'a skostil lum wik yaji, yowalil skan junxo makan lu'um. Ha jun lum chi' yik chonhab' tz'ajkan lu'um. 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj steel lu'um, nanhal yoxil kilómetro tz'aj sat lu'um, yik chonhab' Israel tz'ajkan lu'um.

Hanhejtona', ay chab' makan lum lum, yik winh yajal tz'ajkan lu'um. Ay jun makan lum skan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haxo junxo makan lu'um, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u skan lu'um, syalelk'ochi haton t'a stz'ey lum wik yaji yet' t'a stz'ey lum yik heb' chonhab'. Lajan tz'aj steel lu'um yet' lum yik junjun inhtilal.
Ha jun makan lu'um chi' yik winh yajal Israel tz'ajkan lu'um. Yuj chi', a lum yik heb' in chonhab', manhxo ol yik'ek' lum heb' winh yajal heb' chi', palta ol kan lum t'a junjun makan inhtilal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ex yajal Israel, manhxo eyixtej heb' in chonhab', wach'nhejokab' tzeyutej he b'a, tojolnhej tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan junok tasi. Aktejek he tok'anek' lum slum heb' in chonhab'.
Ha echlab' te tz'akan tze k'ana'.

Ha eyechlab' tze k'an t'a sat eyawb'en, lajanokab' yool yet' eyechlab' tze k'an t'a tas ha' yaji. Ha niwan echlab', haton homer, 220 litro yool, a tz'ak'an yechel masanil echlab'. Ha jun homer chi', lajunhe' bato ha' tz'em t'a yool, lajunhe' pax efa sat awb'en tz'em t'ay.
Hanheja' pax tas tz'echtaj yalil: Ha 20 gera, lajan yalil yet' jun kiklo, haxo pax 60 kiklo lajan yalil yet' jun mina.
Haton juntzanh ofrenda tik yowalil syak' heb' etisraelal: Ha ixim he trigo yet' ixim he kebada 60 makan tzeyutej ixim. Jun makan ixim tzeyak'a'.
Icha pax chi' tzeyutej eyakeite, 100 makan tzeyutej. Jun makan tzeyak'paxi.

Haxo pax nok' kalnel swa b'aj yax anh ank'ultak t'a yol yik Israel, jun nok' tzeyik'el t'a skal 200 ok nok'. Ha in Jehová in swala', masanil juntzanh tik ol k'anchaj t'a ofrendail yet' t'a silab' stz'ai yet' t'a silab' yik junk'olal yet' silab' yuj yak'ji tup smul heb' in chonhab' Israel.
Yowalil masanil in chonhab' Israel tz'ak'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' t'a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.

Ha winh yajal chi' tz'ak'an nok' nok' stz'a silab'il yet' ixim trigo ofrendail yet' wino tz'ak'ji ayik tz'alji k'een uj, t'a k'ual ik'oj ip yet' t'a juntzanh niwak q'uinh wik yaji. Yowalil syak' pax silab' winh yik stup mul, ixim trigo ofrendail, silab' stz'ai, silab' yik junk'olal yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup schukalil heb' yinhtilal Israel.
Ha in Dios Yajal in swala': Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, yowalil tzeyak' junok nok' kelem wakax malaj spaltail yik sakb'ikan in templo.

Ha winh sat sakerdote tz'ik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok' wakax chi', haton nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, sukanoch schiq'uil nok' winh t'a smarkoal spuertail in templo, t'a spatiktak schikintak schanhil yet' t'a yoxmakanhil yich altar chaanh ayk'ei yet' t'a smarkoal spuertail chab'il amak'.
Hanheja' icha chi' tz'aj pax t'a yukil k'ual, yuj yalnhej mach tz'och smul to manh sk'anok sk'ool, mato manh yojtakok tato wan yoch smul. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikanel in templo chi'.
Ayik 14 yoch b'ab'el uj, tze chaanel yich q'uinh yik tze naankot tas ajnak eyelta t'a Egipto. Uke' k'ual tze wa ixim pan malaj yich.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a winh yajal, yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem wakax winh silab'il yuj smul, yuj pax yik masanil heb' chonhab'.

Ha t'a junjun k'u t'a uke' k'ual q'uinh chi', yowalil syak' ukwanh nok' kelemtak wakax winh yajal chi' yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, haton nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail. Snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'ayin. Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa t'a junjun k'u silab'il yuj yak'chaj tup mul.
Ha yet' junjun nok' wakax chi' yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi', tz'ak'jipax 40 libraok ixim trigo yet' nanhal schanhil litrook akeite.

Anhejpaxa' t'a uke' k'ual q'uinh yik chinama, haton jun q'uinh schael yich t'a 15 yoch yukil uj, a winh yajal chi' yowalil syak'nhej silab' winh. Lajan sb'isul nok' silab' chi' syak' winh t'a junjun k'u, icha nok' syak' winh t'a q'uinh yik tze naankot tas ajnak eyelta t'a Egipto, haton nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul, nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yet' ixim trigo yet' akeite ofrendail.
